name: Pop's Cafe Hanceville
summary: A 1950s style diner with chrome counters and checkered floors. Regulars rave about the fluffy pancakes, meatloaf is on the menu every day, and fresh cakes are baked daily. German chocolate is the crowd favorite.

name: Country Wok
summary: The owner trained at a culinary school in New York. Must try picks include the eggrolls, Korean fried wings and Grandma's Cantonese fried rice, and the open kitchen lets you watch it all come together.

name: Hanceville Drug Co Soda Fountain
summary: Step back in time at the soda fountain inside a pharmacy serving Hanceville since 1916. Scoops, sundaes, floats, shakes and the famous cherry ice. Family friendly and oh so sweet.

name: Dodge City Restaurant
summary: Tucked inside the Dodge City Travel Center, this hidden gem is a favorite of locals and truck drivers, who swear by the fried cheeseburger.

name: Coffee Hour Co.
summary: A husband and wife coffee roastery downtown that opened its walk in tasting room in February 2025. Try a flight of coffees from around the world, like a wine tasting with more pep.
address: Commercial Street, beside Hanceville Drug Co.

name: Meatloaf Every Day at Pop's
summary: Pop's Cafe serves meatloaf every day, with chicken and dumplings, dressing and vegetable soup rotating through the week. You can even call ahead to request a dish.

name: Azul Tequila Mexican Cantina
summary: A Mexican cantina on Main Street for tacos and good company. Stop by and tell them we sent you!

name: Cafe Tula Taqueria
summary: A downtown taqueria on Commercial Street, steps from the shops. Stop by and tell them we sent you!

name: Reyes Pizza
summary: Hometown pizza on Main Street for family nights and game day feasts. Stop by and tell them we sent you!

name: HanceVegas Coffee Shop
summary: Downtown coffee with a fun name and a friendly vibe. Stop by and tell them we sent you!

name: Jack's
summary: Southern burgers and biscuits on Styles Street, great for an early breakfast.

name: McDonald's
summary: Quick, family friendly meals on Main Street.

name: Subway
summary: Made to order subs on Main Street for an easy lunch.

name: Taco Bell
summary: Tacos, burritos and late night bites on Main Street.
